description: This file defines the ServerStream struct and its methods, implementing streaming functionality for a gRPC server, including header management, data transmission, and stream control.

classes.name: ServerStream
classes.description: Implements streaming functionality for a gRPC server, managing headers, data, status, and stream state.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a message of specified size from the input stream.

methods.name: SendHeader
methods.description: Sends header metadata for the stream.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes header and data bytes to the output stream.

methods.name: WriteStatus
methods.description: Sends the final status of the stream to the client.

methods.name: isHeaderSent
methods.description: Checks if headers have been sent.

methods.name: updateHeaderSent
methods.description: Sets headerSent to true and returns previous state.

methods.name: RecvCompress
methods.description: Returns the compression algorithm applied to inbound messages.

methods.name: SendCompress
methods.description: Returns the compressor name used for sending.

methods.name: ContentSubtype
methods.description: Returns the content subtype for the request.

methods.name: SetSendCompress
methods.description: Sets the compression algorithm for the stream.

methods.name: SetContext
methods.description: Sets the context of the stream.

methods.name: ClientAdvertisedCompressors
methods.description: Returns compressor names advertised by the client.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Returns the header metadata of the stream.

methods.name: HeaderWireLength
methods.description: Returns the size of the headers as received from the wire.

methods.name: SetTrailer
methods.description: Sets the trailer metadata to be sent with the RPC status.

methods.name: requestRead
methods.description: Adjusts the receive window for reading.
